content_zh:
这是，小荷才露尖尖角么？
还挺美！
原本已经清醒的夏侯擎天在看到眼前的春色后，眼神再次变得迷离。
夏侯擎天一直没回过神，玉绯烟的大眼睛却滴溜溜地转了起来。
此时不跑，等待何时啊！
她慌忙坐起身，扯了衣服胡乱地穿上。
哪知，就在玉绯烟站起来要跑的时候，她细细的脚踝被夏侯擎天一把抓住，惊得她一屁股跌坐在他身上。
“小野猫，吃了就想跑？”
唇上遗留的芳香并没有让夏侯擎天失去理智，他看玉绯烟的眼神变得深邃起来。
满身红肿的鞭伤，脸上骇人的妆容，以及衣服上的斑斑血迹……这小丫头莫不是谁家偷跑出来的奴儿？
夏侯擎天眯着眼。
只是，这奴儿的胆子未免也太胆大了！不但调戏他，还强吻了她，真是胆大包天——
虽然那个吻的感觉还不错，可是这样浅尝辄止的撩拨对一个正常男人来说似乎有些不够，远远不够啊……
“放手！”
对方的大手像手铐一样，将玉绯烟禁锢起来。任她使尽浑身解数，所出的招式都被夏侯擎天一一化解，充分体现出了男女在力量上的差距。
“继续啊——”
如果说夏侯擎天之前只是想逗逗这小野猫，这会儿却对玉绯烟已经产生了浓烈的兴趣。
她那些招式古怪的很，是他从没见过的，却招招致命。
若非这小丫头力道不够，道行太浅，又倘若他只是寻常的普通人，今天吃亏的可就是他了。
也不知道她师承何处！她身上的杀气，不是这个年龄应该拥有的！

还有她表现出的那股不服输的高傲和倔强——
虽然在他眼里脆弱得不堪一击，但是挺有趣！让人忍不住想欺压、碾碎，想看她垂死挣扎、苦苦哀求的模样。
这小野猫，有意思！
他好久都没有遇到这么有趣的宠儿了！
此时，玉绯烟已经深刻地察觉到了她和夏侯擎天之间的差距，也深深地感受到了自己的这幅身子有多没用。
若是在以前，她一定会打得连他妈都认不出他来，哪儿会像现在这样被人当猫儿戏耍！
他以为她是个傻子么？仅用两根手指，就化解了她所有招式，还兴致盎然地看着她。这是打她脸呢！
放过去她怎么会这么狼狈！
见来硬的不行，玉绯烟干脆换了方式。
撕、抓、啃、咬，撒泼耍赖，十八般武艺，她全都使了出来。
反正她是女人，不需要讲江湖道义。更何况她目前只有十三岁，怕啥！
就在玉绯烟再次咬上夏侯擎天肩头的时候，忽然发现一股异样，貌似有什么奇怪东西正贴在她大腿处。
历经两世，玉绯烟自然不是单纯的小萝莉。
一看眼前那张粉若芙蓉的面颊，以及他发红的耳尖，再联想到那凶兽的出处，玉绯烟羞怒地抄起一只鞋，猛地砸在夏侯擎天太阳穴上。
“流氓，找死！”
夏侯擎天吃痛松开手，玉绯烟一个鲤鱼打挺，翻身而起。随后一招“横扫千军”，聚集全身气力，重重一脚踢向美男下身。
踢你个断子绝孙！
察觉到玉绯烟真的恼了，夏侯擎天连忙遮挡关键部位，那一脚最后狠狠地落在他的小腹。
好狠心的小野猫！夏侯擎天龇牙，差一点儿他就蛋碎了——
即便这次得手，玉绯烟也不敢恋战。

她目前还不是这个危险家伙的对手！趁夏侯擎天分神，玉绯烟拔腿就跑，顺便带走了他丢在岸边的衣服。
让你没衣服穿！
让你没脸出去！
让你不敢追我！
看着那个娇小的身影飞奔离开，夏侯擎天缓缓坐起身来。
此时，他白玉似的肩上印着几个小巧的血红牙印，下腹也有一个粉红的脚印，手臂和身上还有几道渗出血丝的爪痕，模样很是狼狈。
真是个桀骜不驯的奴儿！
只是他的定力什么时候变得这般差了？居然被一个小奴儿轻易地挑起了兴致，还差点儿破功……
抚摸着隐隐作痛的太阳穴，夏侯擎天的双眸金光闪闪，野性十足，像发现了猎物的猛兽，充满了狩猎的欲望！
原本以为一年一度的秋季狩猎没什么好玩儿的，哪知道会遇到这么个宝。他一定要把她挖出来，禁锢在身边，即便是给无聊的日子解解闷，逗逗趣儿也好！
拧着玉绯烟落下的粉色小肚兜，夏侯擎天轻笑起来。
有趣的小野猫，我们还会再见面的——

content_en:
Is this how Xiao He is showing off her sharp corners?
Quite beautiful!
Xiahou Qingtian, who was already awake, his eyes became blurred again after seeing the spring scenery in front of him.
Xiahou Qingtian never came back to his senses, but Yu Feiyan's big eyes started to roll.
If you don’t run now, how long will you wait?
She hurriedly sat up, pulled off her clothes and put them on haphazardly.
Unexpectedly, just when Yu Feiyan stood up to run, her thin ankle was grabbed by Xiahou Qingtian, causing her to fall onto him in shock.
"Little wild cat, want to run away after eating?"
The fragrance left on his lips did not make Xiahou Qingtian lose his mind. His eyes when he looked at Yu Feiyan became profound.
The red and swollen whip wounds all over her body, the horrifying makeup on her face, and the blood stains on her clothes...could this little girl be a slave who escaped from someone else's family?
Xiahou Qingtian squinted his eyes.
However, this slave's courage is too bold! Not only did she tease him, but he also kissed her forcefully. It was so audacious——
Although the kiss felt pretty good, such a superficial flirtation seemed a little not enough for a normal man, far from enough...
"Let go!"
The opponent's big hands were like handcuffs, confining Yu Feiyan. No matter how hard she tried, Xiahou Qingtian neutralized all the moves she made, which fully demonstrated the power gap between men and women.
"Go on -"
If Xiahou Qingtian just wanted to tease this little wild cat before, now he has developed a strong interest in Yu Feiyan.
Her moves were very weird, something he had never seen before, but they were deadly.
If this little girl wasn't strong enough and her skills were too shallow, and if he was just an ordinary person, he would be the one who suffered today.
I don’t know where she learned from! The murderous aura in her body is not what she should have at this age!
And the arrogance and stubbornness she showed that refused to admit defeat——
Although it seems fragile to him, it is quite interesting! People can't help but want to bully and crush her, and want to see her dying and begging.
This little wild cat is interesting!
He hasn't met such an interesting darling for a long time!
At this time, Yu Feiyan was deeply aware of the gap between her and Xiahou Qingtian, and also deeply felt how useless her body was.
If it had been in the past, she would have beaten him until he couldn't even recognize his mother. How could he be played like a cat like now!
Did he think she was a fool? With just two fingers, he neutralized all her moves and looked at her with interest. This is a slap in the face!
How could she be so embarrassed if she was let go!
Seeing that it was too hard, Yu Feiyan simply changed her approach.
She used all the eighteen martial arts skills including tearing, scratching, gnawing, biting, playing tricks.
Anyway, she is a woman and does not need to talk about morals. What's more, she is only thirteen years old, so what is she afraid of!
Just when Yu Feiyan bit Xiahou Qingtian's shoulder again, she suddenly noticed something strange, as if something strange was sticking to her thigh.
After two lives, Yu Feiyan is naturally no longer a simple little lolita.
Looking at the pink cheeks in front of her and the red tips of his ears, and then thinking about the origin of the ferocious beast, Yu Feiyan picked up a shoe in shame and anger, and slammed it on Xiahou Qingtian's temple.
"Rogue, seeking death!"
Xiahou Qingtian let go of his hand in pain, and Yu Feiyan stood up like a carp. Then with a "sweeping army" move, he gathered all his strength and kicked the beautiful man's lower body hard.
Kick you to death!
Realizing that Yu Feiyan was really angry, Xiahou Qingtian quickly covered the key parts, and finally the kick landed hard on his lower abdomen.
What a cruel little wild cat! Xiahou Qingtian bared his teeth, and his egg almost broke——
Even if she succeeded this time, Yu Feiyan would not dare to fight.
She is not a match for this dangerous guy yet! While Xia Hou Qingtian was distracted, Yu Feiyan ran away, taking him away and throwing him on the shore.side clothes.
Leave you with no clothes to wear!
Make you embarrassed to go out!
So that you don't dare to chase me!
Seeing that petite figure flying away, Xiahou Qingtian slowly sat up.
At this time, there were several small blood-red tooth marks on his white jade-like shoulders, a pink footprint on his lower abdomen, and several claw marks oozing blood on his arms and body. He looked very embarrassed.
What an unruly slave!
But when did his concentration become so bad? He was actually easily aroused by a little slave, and almost failed...
Stroking his aching temples, Xiahou Qingtian's eyes sparkled with gold, full of wildness, like a beast that had discovered its prey, full of desire to hunt!
I originally thought that the annual autumn hunt would be nothing interesting, but I never knew that I would encounter such a treasure. He must dig her out and keep her close to him, even if it is just to relieve boredom and amuse her!
Twisting Yu Feiyan's pink bellyband, Xiahou Qingtian chuckled.
Funny little wildcat, we will meet again——
